family.template: In the equation x² − {b}x + k = 0, k is a constant. The equation has exactly one real solution. What is the value of k?

stem.en: In the equation x² − {b}x + k = 0, k is a constant. The equation has exactly one real solution. What is the value of k?
stem.uz: x² − {b}x + k = 0 tenglamada k — oʻzgarmas son. Tenglama faqat bitta haqiqiy yechimga ega. k ning qiymati nechaga teng?
stem.ru: В уравнении x² − {b}x + k = 0 число k — постоянная. Уравнение имеет ровно одно действительное решение. Чему равно k?

why.en: Exactly one real solution means the discriminant is zero: b² − 4k = 0.
why.uz: Faqat bitta haqiqiy yechim — diskriminant nolga teng: b² − 4k = 0.
why.ru: Ровно одно действительное решение — дискриминант равен нулю: b² − 4k = 0.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: The graph of y = x² + {b}x + {c} and the line y = {m}x + {n} have exactly one point in common. What is the x-coordinate of that point?

stem.en: The graph of y = x² + {b}x + {c} and the line y = {m}x + {n} have exactly one point in common. What is the x-coordinate of that point?
stem.uz: y = x² + {b}x + {c} parabola va y = {m}x + {n} toʻgʻri chiziq faqat bitta umumiy nuqtaga ega. Shu nuqtaning abssissasi nechaga teng?
stem.ru: Парабола y = x² + {b}x + {c} и прямая y = {m}x + {n} имеют ровно одну общую точку. Найдите абсциссу этой точки.

why.en: Set the two expressions equal; one common point means the quadratic has a double root, x = −(b − m)/2.
why.uz: Ifodalarni tenglang; bitta umumiy nuqta — kvadrat tenglamaning ildizi karrali: x = −(b − m)/2.
why.ru: Приравняйте выражения; одна общая точка — у квадратного уравнения двойной корень: x = −(b − m)/2.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: The number of bacteria in a dish doubles every {d} hours. After {t} hours there are {N} bacteria. How many bacteria were in the dish at the start?

stem.en: The number of bacteria in a dish doubles every {d} hours. After {t} hours there are {N} bacteria. How many bacteria were in the dish at the start?
stem.uz: Idishdagi bakteriyalar soni har {d} soatda ikki baravar ortadi. {t} soatdan keyin bakteriyalar soni {N} ta boʻldi. Boshida idishda nechta bakteriya boʻlgan?
stem.ru: Число бактерий в чашке удваивается каждые {d} ч. Через {t} ч в чашке {N} бактерий. Сколько бактерий было в начале?

why.en: In t hours the number doubles t ÷ d times, so the start = N ÷ 2^(t/d).
why.uz: t soatda son t : d marta ikki baravar ortadi, demak boshlangʻich son = N : 2^(t/d).
why.ru: За t ч число удваивается t : d раз, значит в начале было N : 2^(t/d).

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.

family.template: When p(x) = x³ + {a}x² + kx − {c} is divided by x − {r}, the remainder is {R}. What is the value of k?

derived.R: r**3 + a * r * r + kk * r - c

stem.en: When p(x) = x³ + {a}x² + kx − {c} is divided by x − {r}, the remainder is {R}. What is the value of k?
stem.uz: p(x) = x³ + {a}x² + kx − {c} koʻphad x − {r} ga boʻlinganda qoldiq {R} ga teng. k ning qiymati nechaga teng?
stem.ru: При делении многочлена p(x) = x³ + {a}x² + kx − {c} на x − {r} остаток равен {R}. Найдите k.

why.en: By the remainder theorem p(r) is the remainder: put x = r into p(x), set it equal to the remainder and solve for k.
why.uz: Qoldiq haqidagi teoremaga koʻra p(r) qoldiqqa teng: p(x) ga x = r ni qoʻying, qoldiqqa tenglang va k ni toping.
why.ru: По теореме о остатке p(r) равно остатку: подставьте x = r, приравняйте к остатку и найдите k.

instructions.en: Type your answer as a number.
